backup.privacy: The file holds your child's health data: name, birth date, measurements, medicines, vaccines, notes and every event you logged. It is not encrypted. Keep it somewhere safe, do not send it by email or chat, and delete copies you no longer need.

export.blocked: Only owners and parents can export a baby's data.
export.intro: Download everything the app stores about {{name}} as one file: a backup you can keep, or use to move to another account or server.
export.includes: Included: the profile, every event (deleted ones too), custom event types, medications and prescriptions, formulas, appointments, doctors and clinics, vaccines, growth measurements and the notes you can see.
export.excludes: Not included: other members, invites, a doctor's access, reminders and notification settings, other people's private notes, and anything that identifies a login.
export.sending: Sending the changes made on this device first...
export.unsent: Not everything on this device could be sent first ({{changes}}), so those changes are not in the file.

import.intro: Choose a backup file exported from this app. You will see what it would add before anything is saved. Importing the same file again changes nothing.
import.restoreHint: Creates a new baby with everything in the file, and you become its owner. Best for moving to another account or server.
import.mergeHint: Adds what {{name}} is missing. Nothing is deleted, and where both have the same entry the most recent edit wins.
import.previewNotice: This is a preview: nothing has been saved yet.
import.cannotImport: Some records in this file are not valid, so it cannot be imported.
import.alreadyRestored: You already restored this file into a baby of yours. Importing it adds anything missing to that baby.
import.nothingToDo: There is nothing to import: everything in this file is already there.
import.doneRestore: Done. The baby was created and the data will appear in a moment.
import.doneMerge: Done. The missing data was added and will appear in a moment.

notices.authors_remapped: Entries written by other people ({{count}}) will show as logged by you.
notices.doctor_provenance_dropped: Prescriptions that came from a doctor's proposal ({{count}}) become your own entries.
notices.doctor_measurements_flattened: Consultation measurements ({{count}}) lose their "recorded by" mark.
notices.product_links_dropped: Medications linked to a catalog product this server does not know ({{count}}) are kept without the link.

errors.tooLarge: This file is too large to upload (up to {{limit}}). Export a compressed .json.gz file and try again.
